metadata.description: Curated collection of Claude Code plugins, skills, references, and configurations for modern TypeScript/Bun development, SRE operations, and infrastructure management.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: OxLint, Biome, and Prettier configuration, linting skills, and pre-commit hooks for consistent code quality.

plugins.name: project-scaffold
plugins.description: Mise, justfile, devcontainer, and project template skills for bootstrapping new projects.

plugins.name: infra-ops
plugins.description: SRE commands for incident response, capacity planning, system health checks, and infrastructure analysis.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Superpowers teaches Claude brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD. Additionally, it teaches Claude how to author and test new skills.

plugins.name: huggingface-skills
plugins.description: Build, train, evaluate, and use open source AI models, datasets, and spaces.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry error monitoring integration. Access error reports, analyze stack traces, search issues by fingerprint, and debug production errors directly from your development environment.
